Trade Finance Document Generator

Prepares the export documents presented to a bank under a letter of credit — cover letter and bill of exchange — from a single entry, with the amount written out in words.

Open demo

The original tool is used internally and contains organisation details, so it is not linked here. The demo is a separate rebuild for this portfolio with fictional names (Example Company, Demo Bank) and invented reference numbers. It covers the cover letter and bill of exchange.

The problem

Presenting export documents under a letter of credit means repeating the same LC number, invoice numbers and amount across several documents, and writing the amount out in words. The figures have to agree on every document before they go to the bank.

What it does

  • One form for the LC number, internal reference, customer, currency and one or more invoices; the amount is totalled from the invoices.
  • Cover letter to the bank listing the enclosed documents with original and copy counts, starting from an editable standard set.
  • Bill of exchange in first and second copies, with a supporting-invoice table.
  • Amount in words generated from the figure (for example “… and 50/100 US Dollars”), with a manual override.
  • A certificate of analysis generated from the same entry.
  • Live preview, and printing of one document or all of them.
  • A companion page in the toolkit prepares import-side letters: the LC request, comments before issuance and specimen-signature letters (not included in the demo).
